scope.limitation: Rust entries are the union of locked macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, and Linux x64 normal and build graphs. The Cargo.lock count remains a conservative superset for architectures outside those four reviewed targets.

securityRelevantFeatures.consequence: Provider, Web, and Localmail HTTP use Rustls rather than Reqwest's native-TLS default.
Bottie fixes the Rustls crypto provider to ring.
SQLite is compiled into Bottie and the online-backup API is enabled.
Model retrieval and the checksum-pinned ONNX Runtime build input use Rustls.
Only the two reviewed image decoders are selected.
Portable exports and DOCX parsing select only DEFLATE support.
Optional PDF encryption and time support are not selected.
The compatibility API and target-native credential stores are selected.
The native biometric boundary is compiled only on macOS.

assets.name: Microsoft ONNX Runtime
assets.delivery: The three supported release archives are selected and hash-checked by ort-sys at build time. runtime-assets.json binds their identities to the version-matched licence and upstream notice files.

assets.name: EmbeddingGemma 300M Q4 ONNX model
assets.delivery: Downloaded at runtime into Bottie's application cache; not bundled in this repository or application. runtime-assets.json pins the revision and all six files, and MODEL-NOTICE.txt records the reviewed terms.

assets.delivery: Dynamically supplied by macOS and not redistributed in the application bundle.
